population: Every READY date/lead in the sealed 30-cycle June 2024 coherent forecast result, split into all, prior-ready and newly-ready strata and each lead
reference: Hash-verified 2024 IMD 0.25-degree daily rainfall aligned to valid-date 03-03 UTC; pair only forecast-valid and IMD-valid cells
uncertainty: 1000 fixed-seed initialization-date bootstrap repeats for Brier skill at the two thresholds, descriptive only; cell-level independence is not assumed
no_selection: No fitting, cutoff change, model promotion or evaluation of 2025/2026. June 2024 is consumed development data, and its cutoffs were selected during 2024 development.
release_rule: No independent skill, calibration, operational or public-warning claim. Live worker and dashboard stay unchanged.
